blocks.text: Ogie Alcasid drew excitement among fans as he announced the 2027 staging of his musical “Kailangan Kita,” featuring him and his wife, Asia’s Songbird Regine Velasquez. The OPM veteran announced this through his Facebook page last Saturday, Oct. 31, adding that the musical is scheduled to open in May 2027 at the Newport Performing Arts Theater in Pasay. Alcasid also made a separate announcement during the final show of “Bongga Ka ‘Day!: The Annie Batungbakal Musical,” as seen in the video shared on his page as well. “Next year po, nais ko kayong imbitahan sa aking munting palabas,” he stated, noting […]...
